name: Stonebreaker

abilities.name: Punch
abilities.description: Basic melee attack dealing high physical damage.

abilities.name: Rock Throw
abilities.description: Stonebreaker quickly throws a rock in front of itself, indicated by a quickly cast AoE, dealing high physical damage and stunning you.

abilities.name: Repeat Slam
abilities.description: Stonebreaker slams the ground repeatedly, dealing high physical damage on each one to nearby opponents.

abilities.name: Leap
abilities.description: Stonebreaker jumps over to an opponent far away, dealing very high physical damage and knocking them down. This attack has no indicator.

abilities.name: Raging Fist
abilities.description: Stonebreaker begins pumping its chest rapidly while screaming, before slamming his fist into the ground, causing a huge earthquake all around itself, indicated by a very large growing AoE, causing massive physical damage. This attack must be blocked.

summary: Stonebreaker is a giant armored troll infused with nirncrux, found within Sanctum Ophidia. It's initially held in place by a Serpent Fang and a Serpent War-Priest. He serves as the second boss of the trial.
